items.name: gavamedia/deltafin
items.full_text: Run Kimi K3, a 2.8T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts LLM, on a single Apple Silicon Mac. Streams MXFP4 experts on demand over HTTP into a local disk cache — fused NEON kernels, Metal/MPS compute, exact reproducible decoding, and an OpenAI-compatible API server for local chat and coding agents.

items.name: Noniv/snowflow_demo
items.full_text: A real-time procedural snow rendering demo built with WebGPU, Babylon.js and hand-written WGSL. Features GPU-generated terrain, snow deformation, procedural characters, cloth, surf wakes, water spells, atmosphere and post-processing—without textures, meshes, HDRIs or animation assets.
